newsitem.title: USA: Littelfuse to acquire South Korean firm.
newsitem.headline: Littelfuse to acquire South Korean firm.

text.p: Littelfuse Inc said it signed agreements to acquire Samjoo Electrical Industrial Co Ltd of Seoul, South Korea, for an undisclosed amount.
Samjoo is Korea's largest manufacturer of electronics fuses and has facilities in Korea and the Philippines.
Littelfuse said the acquisition is the second one it has made in Korea in recent years. It acquired Sam Hwa Fuse Co in 1995.
"Our acquisition of Samjoo, along with our earlier acquisition, demonstrates our commitment to the Korean market and to the entire Asia-Pacific region," Howard Witt, chairman, said in a statement.
While the two companies will be run independently, Littelfuse estimates that its total sales in Korea will exceed $17 million on an annual basis.

"Our international sales are growing -- they now account for more than 40 percent of our total sales -- and sales in the Asia-Pacific region are increasing faster than any other region in the world," Bill Barron, vice president of marketing and sales, said in a statement.
Littelfuse makes electronic, power and automotive fuses.
